URL Automotive Industry Portal https://www.marklines.com/en/ Established Jan. 4, 2001 Capital 372,711 thousand yen (as of March 31, 2026) Stock Exchange PRIME Section of Tokyo Stock Exchange (Click here for stock price.) Executives Representative Makoto Sakai (President & CEO) Director Nana Kajiwara Hiroyuki Asada Mitoi Takaku Kazuyuki Kondo Akihiko Shido Hiroshi Miyakawa Company Auditor Masaaki Ueno Junichi Hashiguchi Masami Shinozaki Executive officer Tomohiro Sugano Employees 254 Corporate Philosophy Corporate Mission and Purpose - To develop and grow the automotive industry by providing information services and business support in order to create a better lifestyle for all stakeholders Common Policies and Principles in Performing Work at MarkLines - Mutual Benefit and Prosperity - Open and Sharing - Adaptable to Change Most Important Factors for Work - Be ambitious : continuous effort and progress Business Activities MarkLines provides the "Information Platform", an online information service specialized in the automotive industry, a B2B PR support service “Advertising & Promotion: LINES”, consulting services, vehicle teardown analyses and benchmarking, recruiting, and sales of market forecast data. The Automotive Industry Portal consists of a variety of services, including investments in startup companies. Information Platform For every company aiming for growth in the fast-changing automotive industry, including burgeoning new areas such as electrification and AI, MarkLines provides the only information service of its kind in the world: global coverage of market trends including sales, production, and model changes, latest technologies, vehicle teardown data and analyses, component supplier information, and other proprietary information, packaged and available in Japanese, English, and Chinese. Approximately 200,000 users from 6,000 companies, including component supplier sales and marketing departments as well as vehicle OEM development and purchasing departments, use our services as an antenna for their work. Promotion & Advertising LINES A service that efficiently support the promotion of products and services to Information Platform members through means such as promotional emails and banner ads.
